{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==
*375 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
*3 g [[Cookbook:Cream of Tartar|cream of tartar]]
*2 g [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
*0.8 g ground [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]]
*205 g [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]], melted and cooled slightly
*440 g packed [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*5 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]]

==Procedure==
#Combine flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and nutmeg in a bowl. Set aside.
#Beat together in a large bowl the melted shortening and the brown sugar. Beat in the eggs, then the vanilla extract. Gradually blend in the dry ingredients.
#Shape dough into a log measuring 1½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inches]] in diameter. Wrap log in [[Cookbook:Waxed Paper|waxed paper]] or [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]] and chill for 4 hours or overnight.
#Preheat oven to 375°F (180°C). Lightly grease 2 [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheets]].
# Slice log into slices ¼ inch thick. Place slices 1 inch apart on the baking sheets.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 8–10 minutes until lightly colored. Cool on wire racks.
